svg.text: Dual message injection: Input Spatial (StegaStamp-style) + AdaIN Modulation · Flexible H×W (÷16) · 127 bits · CNN+STN Decoder
All activations: ReLU · Init: Kaiming He
Path 1 (Spatial): message → Linear → Reshape(3,50,50) → Upsample(H,W) → Concat with image at encoder INPUT
Path 2 (Latent): message → MappingNetwork(2×Linear+ReLU) → w(256) → AdaIN modulation at 4 decoder stages
Key insight: message enters at input so ALL U-Net features are message-dependent (not diluted by image-only skip connections)
Input: image (3×H×W) + message (127 bits) → Output: encoded image (3×H×W) · Requires H,W divisible by 16
Output: w latent vector (256) → feeds all 4 AdaIN layers
adain1: AdaIN(w_dim=256, channels=128) · γ,β from w
adain2: AdaIN(w_dim=256, channels=64) · γ,β from w
adain3: AdaIN(w_dim=256, channels=32) · γ,β from w
adain4: AdaIN(w_dim=256, channels=32) · γ,β from w
encoded = image + residual · Output: 3 × H × W
→ Initialized to ZEROS (identity modulation at start)
1. gamma_beta = projection(w) → split into gamma(C), beta(C)
The (1 + γ) formulation ensures identity at init:
When γ=0, β=0: output = x_norm × 1 + 0 = x_norm
Input: encoded image (3×H×W) → Output: decoded bits (127 logits) · STN with scale regularization
Output: raw logits · sigmoid for training
PICODEINE vs OTHER MODELS — KEY DIFFERENCES
1. DUAL message injection: spatial at input (like StegaStamp) + latent via AdaIN at decoder (unique to Picodeine)
2. MappingNetwork: 2-layer MLP (127→256→256) producing style vector w that conditions all 4 AdaIN layers
3. AdaIN modulation: instance-norm + affine from w, with (1+γ) formulation for identity-init stability
4. Zero-initialized AdaIN projections: modulation starts as identity, gradually learns to condition features
5. STN flatten size = 128×(H/8)² (only ÷8 not ÷32) — larger STN than StegaStamp's fixed 320K params
• Same U-Net encoder topology (5 encoder + 4 decoder levels, same channel widths)
• Same residual learning, no BatchNorm, Kaiming He init, all ReLU
• v1: AdaIN-only (bottleneck) → COLLAPSED: message diluted by image-only skip connections
• v2: Added bottleneck spatial injection → COLLAPSED: too deep, still diluted
• v3: Added full-res message skip at output → COLLAPSED: skip bypassed decoder
• v4 (current): Input-level spatial + AdaIN → DESIGNED to prevent collapse via input-level message dependency
